title: Club Membership: tier upgrade and downgrade effective timing
content:
## Scope
This document states when a change from one Club Membership tier to another takes effect, for every tier.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | When a move to a higher tier takes effect | When a move to a lower tier takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |
| Student Metro Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |
| Premier All-Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |
| Black Card All-Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |
| Founding Legacy Access | immediately | at the start of the next billing cycle |

## Reading the table
Every Club Membership tier shares the same effective-timing basis: moving to a higher tier takes effect immediately, while moving to a lower tier takes effect only at the start of the member's next billing cycle, regardless of which two tiers are involved in the change.
